content.text: {"title":"Softmax over the scores","narration":"We left off with scaled scores for three tokens. Here they are, one row per token. Softmax turns each row into weights. Take the first row: zero point five, zero point five, and one. [[expo]]We raise e to each score, giving about one point six five, one point six five, and two point seven two. They add up to about six point zero eight. Dividing each by that total gives the [[row]]weights: point two seven, point two seven, and point four five. Every row now sums to one. Doing all three rows fills the whole grid of attention weights. [[grid]]Each row says where one token looks. In the first row, the [[peak]]strongest weight is the third token, point four five. Now the curve. [[curve]]A larger score gets a larger weight, but the curve flattens at the top, and it saturates near zero and one. That flat region is why large scores give tiny gradients, and why the paper divides by the square root of d k.","objects":[{"kind":"matrix","id":"scores","x":200,"y":200,"rows":[["0.5","0.5","1"],["0","1","0.5"],["1","0.5","0.5"]],"label":"Scaled scores","hidden":false},{"kind":"text","id":"sm_note","x":296,"y":450,"text":"softmax on each row","size":"m"},{"kind":"latex","id":"sm_formula","x":296,"y":560,"tex":"w_{ij}=\\frac{e^{s_{ij}}}{\\sum_k e^{s_{ik}}}"},{"kind":"latex","id":"sm_exp","x":296,"y":700,"tex":"e^{0.5},e^{0.5},e^{1}\\approx 1.65,\\,1.65,\\,2.72","hidden":true}],"objectsJson":"[{\"kind\":\"heatmap\",\"id\":\"attn\",\"x\":760,\"y\":160,\"w\":360,\"h\":300,\"values\":[[0.27,0.27,0.45],[0.19,0.51,0.31],[0.45,0.27,0.27]],\"rowLabels\":[\"t1\",\"t2\",\"t3\"],\"colLabels\":[\"t1\",\"t2\",\"t3\"],\"scale\":{\"min\":0,\"max\":1},\"showValues\":true,\"cellsHidden\":true,\"label\":\"Attention weights\"},{\"kind\":\"plot\",\"id\":\"sig\",\"x\":1000,\"y\":500,\"w\":520,\"h\":380,\"xRange\":[-4,4],\"yRange\":[0,1],\"series\":[{\"points\":[[-4,0.018],[-3.5,0.029],[-3,0.047],[-2.5,0.076],[-2,0.119],[-1.5,0.182],[-1,0.269],[-0.5,0.378],[0,0.5],[0.5,0.622],[1,0.731],[1.5,0.818],[2,0.881],[2.5,0.924],[3,0.953],[3.5,0.971],[4,0.982]],\"label\":\"weight\",\"hidden\":true}],\"xLabel\":\"score gap\",\"yLabel\":\"weight\"}]","actions":[{"do":"show","target":{"id":"sm_exp"},"durationMs":500,"cue":"expo"},{"do":"highlight","target":{"id":"scores","row":0},"durationMs":400,"cue":"expo"},{"do":"show","target":{"id":"attn","row":0},"durationMs":600,"cue":"row"},{"do":"show","target":{"id":"attn","row":1},"durationMs":600,"cue":"grid"},{"do":"show","target":{"id":"attn","row":2},"durationMs":600,"cue":"grid"},{"do":"highlight","target":{"id":"attn","row":0,"col":2},"durationMs":400,"cue":"peak","color":"warn"},{"do":"show","target":{"id":"sig","row":0},"durationMs":1500,"cue":"curve"}]}
